lines.text: In Belshazzar's first year, Daniel dreamed of four great beasts coming up out of the great sea.
The first beast was like a lion, the second like a leopard, and the fourth had ten horns.

wrong_details.true: another beast appeared, which looked like a bear

lines.text: The Ancient of Days took His seat, and One like the Son of Man was given an everlasting kingdom.
Daniel asked someone standing there the meaning, and he said the four beasts were four kings.
The arrogant horn waged war against the saints until the angel Gabriel arrived and pronounced judgment in their favor.
